name: The Coding Agent Stack
description: What an AI coding agent needs to ship a feature: source control, current docs, a real browser to test in, and visibility when something breaks in production.
use_case: Pair an agent with the tools a working developer touches every hour. Read repos, look up library docs, drive a real browser, and see runtime errors.

rationale_per_server.io.github.github/github-mcp-server: Connects the agent to GitHub itself: read code, manage issues and PRs, query workflow runs. The single highest-leverage server for any code task.
rationale_per_server.io.github.upstash/context7: Up-to-date library docs from official sources. Catches the 'this API changed two versions ago' class of agent failures.
rationale_per_server.io.github.ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools: Drives a real Chrome with full DevTools access. Use when the agent needs to actually verify a UI, not just hope the diff looks right.
rationale_per_server.io.github.getsentry/sentry-mcp: Pulls real production errors with stack traces. Closes the loop between 'shipped' and 'still working'.

combined_install:
npx mcp-remote https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp
npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp
npx -y @sentry/mcp-server

name: The Web Researcher Stack
description: Three servers an agent needs to actually read the web: a search engine, a scraper that handles JS, and a converter that turns whatever it pulls back into clean Markdown.
use_case: Build a research agent that searches, scrapes, and digests. Useful for competitive intel, lead research, or feeding fresh sources into a long writeup.

rationale_per_server.io.github.tavily-ai/tavily-mcp: Search built for LLMs, not humans. Returns clean results without ad cruft.
rationale_per_server.firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server: Renders JS-heavy pages and returns clean Markdown. The thing you want when basic curl scraping returns an empty shell.
rationale_per_server.microsoft/markitdown: Converts PDFs, Word docs, slides, and images to Markdown. The bridge between 'I found a source' and 'I can quote it'.

combined_install:
npx -y tavily-mcp
npx -y firecrawl-mcp
uvx markitdown-mcp

name: The Data Stack
description: An agent that can speak to your data. One Postgres server, one document store, one vector DB. Enough surface to prototype most data workflows without dragging in five admin tools.
use_case: Wire an agent to the storage layer of a typical app. Run analytics queries, look up records, or seed a vector store from documents.

rationale_per_server.neondatabase/mcp-server-neon: Postgres on Neon, including branching and migrations. The serverless-Postgres half of most modern stacks.
rationale_per_server.io.github.mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server: Run queries and aggregations against MongoDB Atlas or self-hosted. The document store half.
rationale_per_server.chroma-core/chroma-mcp: Open-source vector database for retrieval. Use it when the agent needs to remember things across sessions.

combined_install:
npx mcp-remote https://mcp.neon.tech/sse
npx -y mongodb-mcp-server
uvx chroma-mcp
